signal: Rilla hit $70M ARR in April 2026, up from $51M, and launched Rilla Live real-time field-sales coaching

email.body1:
Caden, saw Rilla crossed $70M ARR this spring, up from $51M, and shipped Rilla Live for real-time field coaching.

Growth that fast usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount, 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Rilla off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Caden, quick follow-up for Rilla.

At that growth rate, the number jumps faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit it, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter turns into a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Rilla needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Caden, last bit of proof for Rilla.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Rilla's reply rate likely compares to other high-growth sales-tech startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Caden, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Hypergrowth is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a high-growth sales motion? I'll tailor it to Rilla either way.
